root_cause: The radios component only updates conditional visibility on click events, not when the checked state changes via keyboard navigation (arrow keys).
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener that invokes the same update logic used for clicks, ensuring that when arrow keys change the selected radio, the associated conditional fields are shown or hidden correctly.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can now navigate the radio group with arrow keys and see conditional fields appear/disappear correctly, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Both click and change events may fire for the same interaction (e.g., mouse click), but the update logic is idempotent.
Negligible performance impact from an additional event listener.
verification_requirements: Verify that arrow key navigation updates visibility of conditionals as expected.
Verify that mouse clicks continue to work correctly.
Verify that the form data reflects the selected value after keyboard navigation.
Ensure no regression in existing tests or functionality.
